newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: About 200 killed in Colombian war so far this year.
newsitem.headline: About 200 killed in Colombian war so far this year.

text.p: At least 50 soldiers and 140 leftist guerrillas died in fighting across Colombia during the first three months of the year, military sources said on Friday.

The sources, citing what they said were official casualty statistics, offered no comparative figures for 1996. But judicial police said "acts of terrorism" -- crimes generally defined as bombings and other rebel attacks -- were up 46 percent in the first quarter over the same period a year ago.
In the latest incident five Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC) rebels were killed in a clash with troops on Friday in a jungle area in northwest Colombia, a military spokesman said.
The FARC, which evolved from peasant militias in 1948, was officially formed a pro-Soviet group in 1964 and ranks as Latin America's largest and longest-lasting insurgency.
